zh-CN: 新增直接 CLI 任务入口，支持项目粒度、任务级重复处理、结果文件和丢响应恢复。
任务配置在受理时固定；完成回执按仓库保存，清队列后仍可离线查询。
MCP 请求共用总时限并保留启动诊断；原有桌面流程与用户资料位置保持兼容。
仓库搜索返回超过 2000 条的完整匹配；异常归档源处置完成后保存失败时，离线回执保留恢复线索。
en-US: Direct CLI tasks now support project layout, task-scoped duplicate handling, result files, and lost-response recovery.
Execution settings are frozen at admission; terminal receipts remain available offline after queue cleanup.
MCP calls share a total deadline and retain launch diagnostics; desktop flows and user data locations stay compatible.
Warehouse search returns all matches beyond 2,000 items; offline receipts retain recovery evidence when saving the final source action fails after abnormal archive confirmation.
